status: Post-hoc publication audit; original experiment specification and screen unchanged.
inputs: Lowest public row CSV norms first; unit JSONL, original aggregate and initial README used only as validation comparators after calculation.
unit_reconstruction: sqrt(sum(row abs_error squared)/sum(row reference_norm squared)); rounded FP32 row norms are promoted to float64.

bootstrap.name: post-hoc clustered uncertainty analysis
bootstrap.cluster: 16 evaluation document IDs, paired across methods; all 3 layers x 4 heads included per draw; same draws for all lengths
statistics: median error difference in percentage points
bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5/97.5, descriptive; no p-values, equivalence or screen modification

failure_diagnostics.population: Block 32 EFQ-Mean and calibrated valid rows with relative output error >=0.20
failure_diagnostics.interpretation: Overlapping descriptive flags only. These do not establish dominant mechanisms. Global nonzero-boundary classification is unavailable without per-key score/code records. Dominant attribution remains unresolved; inspect the recorded representative case separately.

changes_allowed: New derived analysis, prose and manifests only; no original measurements, frozen files, parameters or screen changes.
